checkIntervalError: At least 10 minutes without own app, at least 1 minute with own app
checkIntervalHelp: Netatmo updates weather data about every 10 minutes. Cameras and alarms are polled at twice this interval.
cleanupHelp: How often old events and persons are removed
cleanupIntervalError: At least 20 minutes without own app, at least 5 minutes with own app
elevationHelp: Above sea level, used for the dew point calculation
iotInstanceHelp: Leave empty to disable realtime events
loginInfo: The button opens the Netatmo login in a new window. Log in again after changing the selected products or the client ID/secret, otherwise data may be missing. If no window opens, check the popup blocker.
ownAppInfo: With your own app at dev.netatmo.com you get your own API quota. It is required for doorbell, smoke and CO alarm, the full camera functions and update intervals below 10 minutes. Create an app and enter its client ID and client secret here.
realtimeInfo: Netatmo sends realtime events (cameras, doorbell, smoke and CO alarm) via the ioBroker cloud. This requires an iot instance connected to an ioBroker Pro account with an Assistant or Remote license. Without it, data is only updated by polling.
welcomeHelp: Live stream and full camera control only with own app
